title: The “Send 1, Get 2 Back” Giveaway Scam
summary: A persistent scam promises that if you send some crypto to an address, you will get back double — often dressed up with a famous name, a countdown, and fake “proof” of others being paid.
blocks: A persistent scam promises that if you send some crypto to an address, you will get back double — often dressed up with a famous name, a countdown, and fake “proof” of others being paid.
It is simple theft: anything you send is gone, and the “winners” shown are fabricated. No real giveaway asks you to send funds first to receive more.
Fake livestreams and hacked accounts are frequently used to make these look official. Sending money to receive money back is never how a legitimate promotion works.
